about: Everpool record and pool id vectors (SPEC.md sections 1, 2 and 4). Generated from the reference implementation's src/poolrecord.cpp, not from lib/. Byte strings are lowercase hex. A reason is the first rule the record breaks, in the order of SPEC.md section 1 as the reference checks it; error is the reference's own text.
